<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Project Compass — S&OP Demand Planning Workspace (Prototype)</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --cherry:#990011; --cherry-dark:#7a000d; --cherry-tint:#FBEAEC;
    --navy:#2F3C7E; --navy-tint:#EBEDF6;
    --ink:#20232B; --muted:#6B6B6B; --faint:#9A9591;
    --bg:#F6F5F4; --card:#FFFFFF; --border:#E5E0DF;
    --green:#1E7B4D; --green-bg:#E9F5EE;
    --amber:#B4720A; --amber-bg:#FBF1DF;
    --red:#B33A3A; --red-bg:#FBEAEA;
    --gray:#6B6B6B; --gray-bg:#EAEAE9;
    --font-display:"Cambria","Georgia",serif;
    --font-body:"Calibri","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
    --font-mono:"Consolas","SFMono-Regular",Menlo,monospace;
    --radius:10px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;}
  body{
    font-family:var(--font-body);
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  .app{display:flex; min-height:100vh;}

  /* ---------------- SIDEBAR ---------------- */
  .sidebar{
    width:268px; flex:0 0 268px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0A0A0A 0%, #171717 100%);
    color:#fff; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    padding:22px 16px;
  }
  .brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:4px 8px 22px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .brand-mark{
    width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:var(--cherry);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:16px;
  }
  .brand-text .t1{font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:1.5px; color:#8A8A8A; font-weight:600;}
  .brand-text .t2{font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; font-family:var(--font-display);}

  .nav-label{font-size:10px; letter-spacing:1.5px; color:#7A7A7A; text-transform:uppercase; margin:14px 10px 8px;}
  .nav-item{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:10px 10px; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer;
    color:#CFCFCF; font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:2px; transition:background .15s ease;
    position:relative;
  }
  .nav-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
  .nav-item.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16); color:#fff; font-weight:600;}
  .nav-dot{width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; flex:0 0 8px;}
  .dot-auto{background:#4FD48A;}
  .dot-semi{background:#F0B84B;}
  .dot-manual{background:#F0837F;}
  .dot-discuss{background:#C9AFEA;}
  .dot-complete{background:#4FD48A;}
  .dot-progress{background:#F0B84B;}
  .dot-pending{background:#8A8A8A;}
  .nav-step-no{
    font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:10px; color:#6B6B6B; width:16px; text-align:right; flex:0 0 16px;
  }
  .nav-item.active .nav-step-no{color:#fff;}
  .sidebar-footer{margin-top:auto; padding:12px 10px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); font-size:10.5px; color:#6B6B6B;}

  /* ---------------- MAIN ---------------- */
  main{flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:0;}
  .topbar{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:16px 28px; background:var(--card); border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:5;
  }
  .topbar-left h1{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:20px; margin:0 0 2px; font-weight:700;}
  .topbar-left p{margin:0; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted);}
  .topbar-controls{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;}
  select, .btn, input.text-input{
    font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:12.5px; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:8px 12px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink);
  }
  select{cursor:pointer;}
  .btn{cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; white-space:nowrap;}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--cherry); border-color:var(--cherry); color:#fff;}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--cherry-dark);}
  .btn-outline{background:#fff; border-color:var(--border); color:var(--ink);}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--cherry); color:var(--cherry);}
  .btn-sm{padding:5px 10px; font-size:11.5px; border-radius:6px;}
  .btn:disabled{opacity:.45; cursor:not-allowed;}

  .content{padding:24px 28px 60px; overflow-y:auto;}
  .screen{display:none;}
  .screen.active{display:block; animation:fadeIn .18s ease;}
  @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(4px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}}

  .eyebrow{font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:1.6px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--cherry); font-weight:700; margin:0 0 4px;}
  .h2{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:22px; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 6px;}
  .subcopy{color:var(--muted); font-size:12.5px; margin:0 0 20px; max-width:820px;}

  .badge{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:20px;}
  .badge-auto{background:var(--green-bg); color:var(--green);}
  .badge-semi{background:var(--amber-bg); color:var(--amber);}
  .badge-manual{background:var(--red-bg); color:var(--red);}
  .badge-discuss{background:#F1E9FA; color:#6B3FA0;}
  .badge-oos{background:var(--gray-bg); color:var(--gray);}
  .badge-complete{background:var(--green-bg); color:var(--green);}
  .badge-progress{background:var(--amber-bg); color:var(--amber);}
  .badge-pending{background:#ECECEC; color:#7A7A7A;}

  /* Cards / grid */
  .grid{display:grid; gap:16px;}
  .grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
  .grid-2{grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr;}
  .card{
    background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:18px 20px;
  }
  .card h3{margin:0 0 4px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700;}
  .card .kpi{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:30px; font-weight:700; margin:4px 0 2px;}
  .card .kpi-sub{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted);}
  .kpi-trend{font-size:11px; font-weight:700;}
  .trend-up{color:var(--green);}
  .trend-down{color:var(--red);}

  /* Process tracker (home) */
  .tracker{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; overflow-x:auto; padding:6px 2px 14px;}
  .tstep{flex:1 1 0; min-width:96px; text-align:center; position:relative; padding:0 4px;}
  .tstep .tline{position:absolute; top:15px; left:-50%; width:100%; height:2px; background:var(--border); z-index:0;}
  .tstep:first-child .tline{display:none;}
  .tdot{width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%; margin:0 auto 8px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
        font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; position:relative; z-index:1; border:3px solid var(--bg);}
  .tlabel{font-size:9.8px; color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; line-height:1.25;}
  .towner{font-size:9.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px;}

  /* Tables */
  table{width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px;}
  thead th{
    text-align:left; font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.4px; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted);
    padding:9px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); background:#FBFAFA; font-weight:700;
  }
  tbody td{padding:10px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); vertical-align:middle;}
  tbody tr:hover{background:#FCFAF9;}
  .num{font-family:var(--font-mono); text-align:right;}
  .cell-input{
    width:84px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:12px; padding:5px 7px; border-radius:5px;
    border:1px solid var(--border); text-align:right;
  }
  .cell-input:focus{outline:none; border-color:var(--cherry);}
  .row-fade{animation:rowFade .5s ease;}
  @keyframes rowFade{from{background:#FCEFD4;} to{background:transparent;}}
  .strike{text-decoration:line-through; color:var(--faint);}

  .toolbar{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:14px; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .toolbar-filters{display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  .dropzone{
    border:1.5px dashed var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius); padding:22px; text-align:center;
    color:var(--muted); font-size:12.5px; background:#FCFBFB; margin-bottom:18px; transition:border-color .15s;
  }
  .dropzone.drag{border-color:var(--cherry); color:var(--cherry); background:var(--cherry-tint);}
  .dropzone b{color:var(--ink); font-weight:700;}

  .panel-note{
    border-radius:var(--radius); padding:14px 16px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5; border:1px solid;
    margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .panel-note.discuss{background:#F6F1FB; border-color:#D7C4EC; color:#5A3A82;}
  .panel-note.oos{background:var(--gray-bg); border-color:#D6D3D1; color:#4E4C4A;}
  .panel-note.warn{background:var(--amber-bg); border-color:#EAD3A0; color:#7A5205;}

  .status-pill{font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:20px; display:inline-block;}
  .status-draft{background:#EFEFEF; color:#666;}
  .status-submitted{background:var(--navy-tint); color:var(--navy);}
  .status-approved{background:var(--green-bg); color:var(--green);}
  .status-frozen{background:#E7F2FB; color:#1D6FA5;}

  .actions{display:flex; gap:6px;}

  /* Simple bar chart */
  .barchart{display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:10px; height:150px; padding-top:10px;}
  .bar-col{flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; height:100%;}
  .bar{width:60%; border-radius:4px 4px 0 0; background:var(--navy); position:relative;}
  .bar.two{background:var(--cherry);}
  .bar-label{font-size:9.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:6px;}
  .bar-value{font-size:9.5px; font-family:var(--font-mono); color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:3px;}

  .legend-row{display:flex; gap:16px; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:8px;}
  .legend-dot{display:inline-block; width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:2px; margin-right:5px; vertical-align:middle;}

  .waterfall{display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:4px; height:170px; padding:10px 0;}
  .wf-col{flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end;}
  .wf-bar{width:70%; border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;}
  .wf-label{font-size:9px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:6px; text-align:center;}

  .footer-note{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--faint); margin-top:8px; font-style:italic;}

  ::-webkit-scrollbar{height:8px; width:8px;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#D8D3D1; border-radius:4px;}

  /* ---------------- Exec Summary (Monthly Pack) ---------------- */
  .subtabs{display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom:0;}
  .subtab{
    font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:var(--muted); padding:8px 14px; cursor:pointer;
    border-bottom:2px solid transparent; margin-bottom:-1px;
  }
  .subtab:hover{color:var(--ink);}
  .subtab.active{color:var(--cherry); border-bottom-color:var(--cherry);}
  .subview{display:none;}
  .subview.active{display:block; animation:fadeIn .18s ease;}

  .cell-red{background:var(--red); color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-mono); text-align:right; font-weight:700;}
  .cell-green{background:var(--green); color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-mono); text-align:right; font-weight:700;}
  .cell-gray-total{background:#DADADA; font-family:var(--font-mono); text-align:right; font-weight:700;}
  table.pack-table{font-size:11.5px;}
  table.pack-table thead th{background:var(--ink); color:#fff; font-size:9.5px;}
  table.pack-table td.rowhead{background:#F1F0EF; font-weight:700; font-family:var(--font-body); text-align:left;}
  table.pack-table td.subhead{font-family:var(--font-body); text-align:left;}
  table.pack-table tr.total-row td{background:#EDEDED; font-weight:700;}
  table.pack-table tr.total-row td.cell-red{background:var(--red); color:#fff;}
  table.pack-table tr.total-row td.cell-green{background:var(--green); color:#fff;}

  .bridge{display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:10px; height:230px; padding:26px 0 10px;}
  .bridge-col{flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; height:100%; min-width:60px;}
  .bridge-bar{width:66%; border-radius:3px 3px 0 0; background:var(--cherry);}
  .bridge-value{font-size:11px; font-family:var(--font-mono); margin-bottom:4px; font-weight:700;}
  .bridge-label{font-size:9.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:6px; text-align:center; line-height:1.25;}

  .reason-box{
    border-left:3px solid var(--cherry); background:var(--cherry-tint); padding:12px 16px; border-radius:6px;
    font-size:12px; line-height:1.7; margin-top:16px;
  }
  .reason-box b{color:var(--cherry-dark);}

  .constraint-cell{font-size:11px; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.5;}
  .constraint-cell b{font-weight:700;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">

  <!-- ============ SIDEBAR ============ -->
  <aside class="sidebar">
    <div class="brand" style="flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px;">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="ELGi — Always Better" style="width:150px; height:auto; display:block;" />
      <div class="brand-text">
        <div class="t1">PROJECT COMPASS</div>
        <div class="t2">S&OP Workspace</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="nav-label">Overview</div>
    <div class="nav-item active" data-screen="home">
      <span class="nav-step-no">•</span><span class="nav-dot dot-complete"></span> Pilot Overview
    </div>

    <div class="nav-label">Process Steps</div>
    <div class="nav-item" data-screen="master">
      <span class="nav-step-no">1</span><span class="nav-dot dot-complete"></span> DFU / TPL Master
    </div>
    <div class="nav-item" data-screen="forecast">
      <span class="nav-step-no">2</span><span class="nav-dot dot-progress"></span> Stat Forecast, File Prep &amp; Net Demand
    </div>
    <div class="nav-item" data-screen="workspace">
      <span class="nav-step-no">3</span><span class="nav-dot dot-progress"></span> Demand Planning Workspace
    </div>

    <div class="nav-label">Analytics</div>
    <div class="nav-item" data-screen="dashboard">
      <span class="nav-step-no">•</span><span class="nav-dot" style="background:#8B8FBF;"></span> Exec Dashboard
    </div>
    <div class="nav-item" data-screen="rrs">
      <span class="nav-step-no">•</span><span class="nav-dot" style="background:#8B8FBF;"></span> RRS Classification
    </div>

    <div class="sidebar-footer">
      Prototype build — for stakeholder walkthrough only.<br/>Not connected to live data.
    </div>
  </aside>

  <!-- ============ MAIN ============ -->
  <main>
    <div class="topbar">
      <div class="topbar-left">
        <h1 id="topbar-title">Pilot Overview</h1>
        <p id="topbar-sub">July 2026 pilot &nbsp;·&nbsp; All Regions</p>
      </div>
      <div class="topbar-controls">
        <select id="pilotMonth">
          <option>July 2026 Pilot</option>
          <option>June 2026 Pilot</option>
          <option>May 2026 Pilot</option>
        </select>
        <select id="regionFilter">
          <option>All Regions</option>
          <option>USA</option>
          <option>Europe</option>
          <option>India</option>
        </select>
        <button class="btn btn-outline">Export</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="content">

      <!-- ================= HOME ================= -->
      <section class="screen active" id="screen-home">
        <div class="eyebrow">Overview</div>
        <div class="h2">Pilot Health at a Glance</div>
        <p class="subcopy">A single view of where this month's pilot stands across the process. Click any step below or in the left rail to open it.</p>

        <div class="grid grid-3" style="margin-bottom:22px;">
          <div class="card">
            <h3>Open Items</h3>
            <div class="kpi">8</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">Awaiting stakeholder decision</div>
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <h3>Pilot Progress</h3>
            <div class="kpi">4 / 9</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">Steps completed this month</div>
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <h3>Forecast Accuracy</h3>
            <div class="kpi">88.4%</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub trend-up">▲ 2.1 pts vs. last pilot</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:22px;">
          <div style="display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;">
            <h3 style="margin-bottom:2px;">Process Flow Status</h3>
            <span class="footer-note" style="margin:0; font-style:normal;">As of <b style="color:var(--ink);">July 2, 2026 · 09:00 IST</b></span>
          </div>
          <p class="footer-note" style="margin-top:0; margin-bottom:6px;">Shows how far this month's pilot has progressed through each stage of the process.</p>
          <div class="tracker" id="tracker"></div>
          <div class="legend-row">
            <span><span class="legend-dot" style="background:#1E7B4D"></span>Complete</span>
            <span><span class="legend-dot" style="background:#B4720A"></span>In Progress</span>
            <span><span class="legend-dot" style="background:#8A8A8A"></span>Yet to Start</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-2">
          <div class="card">
            <h3>This Month's Watch-outs</h3>
            <table>
              <tbody>
                <tr><td>3 TPLs missing from master (auto-detected)</td><td><span class="badge badge-auto">Auto-flagged</span></td></tr>
                <tr><td>OTIF data validation in progress</td><td><span class="badge badge-progress">In progress</span></td></tr>
                <tr><td>Europe &amp; USA DFU data completeness below 70%</td><td><span class="badge badge-progress">Watch</span></td></tr>
                <tr><td>UCD upload complete for all regions</td><td><span class="badge badge-complete">Done</span></td></tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <h3>New / Upcoming Release Notes</h3>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6;">
              <b style="color:var(--green);">✓ Added:</b> Single consolidated Exec Dashboard, including Waterfall &amp; Inventory automation.<br/><br/>
              <b style="color:var(--green);">✓ Added:</b> Net Demand &amp; Constraints merged into Stat Forecast &amp; File Prep for one continuous workflow.<br/><br/>
              <b style="color:var(--amber);">🔜 Coming next:</b> ASN integration from the Supply Portal — pending a scoping workshop with S&amp;OP.<br/><br/>
              <b style="color:var(--gray);">⛔ Not planned:</b> Automated Production + Supplier constraint allocation logic (confirmed out of scope).
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ================= MASTER ================= -->
      <section class="screen" id="screen-master">
        <div class="eyebrow">Step 1 · Automated</div>
        <div class="h2">DFU / TPL Master Updation</div>
        <p class="subcopy">TPLs missing from the master are detected automatically against the exception report (Regional Item Master, SO, PO, order inflow) and can be appended in one action.</p>

        <div class="grid grid-3" style="margin-bottom:18px;">
          <div class="card">
            <h3>Total DFUs</h3>
            <div class="kpi">76,645</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">Across 11 regions in the master</div>
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <h3>New Added Today</h3>
            <div class="kpi">14</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub trend-up">▲ via automated exception detection</div>
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <h3>Data Quality</h3>
            <div class="kpi">59.9%</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">Complete on Product Group &amp; Model fields</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px;">
          <h3 style="margin-bottom:2px;">Data Completeness by Region</h3>
          <p class="footer-note" style="margin-top:0; margin-bottom:10px;">Share of DFUs with Product Group and Model populated — from the current DFU Master file.</p>
          <table>
            <thead><tr><th>Region</th><th class="num">Total DFUs</th><th class="num">Complete %</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr><td>Indonesia</td><td class="num">1,458</td><td class="num">4.3%</td><td><span class="badge badge-manual">Critical</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>Malaysia</td><td class="num">589</td><td class="num">9.7%</td><td><span class="badge badge-manual">Critical</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>Europe</td><td class="num">18,540</td><td class="num">13.0%</td><td><span class="badge badge-manual">Critical</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>ID</td><td class="num">948</td><td class="num">27.5%</td><td><span class="badge badge-manual">Critical</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>South Africa</td><td class="num">849</td><td class="num">37.2%</td><td><span class="badge badge-semi">Watch</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>USA</td><td class="num">33,664</td><td class="num">67.0%</td><td><span class="badge badge-semi">Watch</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>Middle East (New)</td><td class="num">2,189</td><td class="num">94.7%</td><td><span class="badge badge-auto">Good</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>Australia</td><td class="num">2,763</td><td class="num">95.3%</td><td><span class="badge badge-auto">Good</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>Brazil</td><td class="num">2,542</td><td class="num">97.4%</td><td><span class="badge badge-auto">Good</span></td></tr>
              <tr><td>India</td><td class="num">12,015</td><td class="num">99.4%</td><td><span class="badge badge-auto">Good</span></td></tr>

            <h3>CV² (Squared Coefficient of Variation)</h3>
            <div class="kpi" style="font-size:22px;">Variability Test</div>
            <div class="kpi-sub">CV² ≤ 0.49 → stable/smooth demand (Runner); CV² &gt; 0.49 → erratic demand (Repeater/Stranger)</div>

        </div>

<script>
  // ---------- Navigation ----------
  const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
  const screens = document.querySelectorAll('.screen');
  const titles = {
    home: ['Pilot Overview', 'July 2026 pilot · All Regions'],
    master: ['DFU / TPL Master', 'Step 1 of the pilot process'],
    forecast: ['Stat Forecast, File Prep & Net Demand', 'Step 2 of the pilot process'],
    workspace: ['Demand Planning Workspace', 'Step 3 of the pilot process'],
    dashboard: ['Exec Dashboard', 'Analytics · Consolidated view & source reports'],
    rrs: ['RRS Classification', 'Analytics · Runner / Repeater / Stranger mix'],
  };
  navItems.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navItems.forEach(n => n.classList.remove('active'));
      item.classList.add('active');
      const target = item.getAttribute('data-screen');
      screens.forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
      document.getElementById('screen-' + target).classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('topbar-title').textContent = titles[target][0];
      document.getElementById('topbar-sub').textContent = titles[target][1];
    });
  });

  // ---------- Home process tracker ----------
  const trackerSteps = [
    { label: 'DFU Master Updation', owner: 'IT - Data', status: 'complete' },
    { label: 'Stat Forecast Gen', owner: 'IT - Data', status: 'complete' },
    { label: 'Forecast File Distribution', owner: 'IT - Data', status: 'complete' },
    { label: 'UCD Upload by Region', owner: 'Region', status: 'complete' },
    { label: 'PowerBI Demand Review', owner: 'IT - Data', status: 'progress' },
    { label: 'S&OP Review & Approve', owner: 'S&OP Team', status: 'pending' },
    { label: 'Net Demand & Constraint Calc', owner: 'S&OP', status: 'pending' },
    { label: 'Net Demand Upload', owner: 'IT - Data', status: 'pending' },
    { label: 'Exec Dashboard', owner: 'IT - Data', status: 'pending' },
  ];
  const statusColor = { complete: '#1E7B4D', progress: '#B4720A', pending: '#C7C5C3' };
  const tracker = document.getElementById('tracker');
  trackerSteps.forEach((s, i) => {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'tstep';
    const dotContent = s.status === 'complete' ? '✓' : (i + 1);
    const textColor = s.status === 'pending' ? 'color:#B0ADAB;' : '';
    div.innerHTML = `<div class="tline"></div><div class="tdot" style="background:${statusColor[s.status]};">${dotContent}</div>
      <div class="tlabel" style="${textColor}">${s.label}</div><div class="towner" style="${textColor}">${s.owner}</div>`;
    tracker.appendChild(div);
  });

  // ---------- Master table ----------
  const masterData = [
    { tpl: 'TPL-30217', region: 'India', dfu: 'DFU-10231', via: 'SO Exception', cls: 'Unit', status: 'pending' },
    { tpl: 'TPL-30288', region: 'USA', dfu: 'DFU-11290', via: 'Order Inflow', cls: 'Unit', status: 'pending' },
    { tpl: 'TPL-30355', region: 'Europe', dfu: 'DFU-10874', via: 'PO Exception', cls: 'Accessory', status: 'pending', needsCheck: true },
  ];
  function renderMasterTable(){
    const body = document.getElementById('masterTableBody');
    body.innerHTML = '';
    masterData.forEach((row, idx) => {
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.id = 'mrow-' + idx;
      const statusHtml = row.status === 'added'
        ? '<span class="badge badge-auto">Added ✓</span>'
        : '<span class="badge badge-semi">Pending</span>';
      const clsHtml = row.needsCheck ? row.cls + ' <span class="badge badge-semi" style="padding:1px 6px;">Verify</span>' : row.cls;
      tr.innerHTML = `<td>${row.tpl}</td><td>${row.region}</td><td>${row.dfu}</td><td>${row.via}</td><td>${clsHtml}</td>
        <td>${statusHtml}</td>
        <td><button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm add-btn" data-idx="${idx}" ${row.status==='added'?'disabled':''}>${row.status==='added'?'Added':'Add to Master'}</button></td>`;
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.add-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const idx = btn.getAttribute('data-idx');
        masterData[idx].status = 'added';
        renderMasterTable();
        document.getElementById('mrow-' + idx).classList.add('row-fade');
      });
    });
  }
  renderMasterTable();
  document.getElementById('addAllBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    masterData.forEach(r => r.status = 'added');
    renderMasterTable();
  });

  // ---------- Workspace table ----------
  const workspaceData = [
    { dfu: 'DFU-10231', region: 'India', stat: 142, ucd: 150, mud: 146, status: 'submitted' },
    { dfu: 'DFU-10874', region: 'Europe', stat: 76, ucd: 76, mud: 76, status: 'approved' },
    { dfu: 'DFU-11290', region: 'USA', stat: 211, ucd: 220, mud: 214, status: 'draft' },
    { dfu: 'DFU-11530', region: 'India', stat: 0, ucd: 15, mud: 15, status: 'draft' },

        const shiftClass = shiftVal > 0 ? 'trend-up' : (shiftVal < 0 ? 'trend-down' : '');
        html += `<tr>${i===0 ? `<td class="rowhead" rowspan="3">${d.region}</td>` : ''}<td class="subhead">${classLabels[k]}</td>
          <td class="num">${d[k]}%</td><td class="num ${shiftClass}">${arrow} ${Math.abs(shiftVal)} pts</td></tr>`;
      });
    });
    body.innerHTML = html;
  })();

  // ---------- Download RRS (CSV export) ----------
  (function wireRrsDownload(){
    const btn = document.getElementById('downloadRrsBtn');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const classLabels = { runner: 'Runner', repeater: 'Repeater', stranger: 'Stranger' };
      let csv = 'Region,RRS Class,Volume Contribution (%),Shift vs Previous Pilot (pts)\n';
      rrsData.forEach(d => {
        ['runner','repeater','stranger'].forEach(k => {
          csv += `${d.region},${classLabels[k]},${d[k]},${d.shift[k]}\n`;
        });
      });
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = 'RRS_Classification.csv';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    });
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
